scenes.heading: The first whistle
scenes.title: The first whistle
scenes.narration: On a straight training lane, Asha starts at four metres per second. Ben waits five seconds for a second whistle. Where is Asha when Ben starts? Mark every metre she has already run. Four metres in each of five seconds gives a twenty metre lead.

scenes.heading: Run both stopwatches
scenes.title: Run both stopwatches
scenes.narration: After his whistle, Ben runs at seven metres per second. Keep one stopwatch running from the first whistle and start another from the second. Over one more second Asha gains four metres and Ben gains seven. The gap shrinks by three metres.

scenes.heading: Meet on the lane
scenes.title: Meet on the lane
scenes.narration: How long does Ben run before drawing level? He must close twenty metres at three metres per second. After six seconds the gap is still two metres. Two thirds of another second closes that gap. Ben runs for six and two thirds seconds.

scenes.heading: Read the earlier clock
scenes.title: Read the earlier clock
scenes.narration: The first stopwatch started five seconds earlier. It reads eleven and two thirds seconds when they meet. Asha has run four times that reading. Ben has run seven times his own reading. Both are forty-six and two thirds metres from the starting line.

scenes.heading: Two directions around a track
scenes.title: Two directions around a track
scenes.narration: On a new course, one lap is three hundred metres. Asha now runs at two metres per second. Ben waits five seconds and then runs the other way at three metres per second. When Ben sets off, Asha has already used ten metres of the lap.

scenes.heading: Find the first meeting
scenes.title: Find the first meeting
scenes.narration: Once both are moving, they cover five metres of the track between them each second. Two hundred and ninety metres remain before their first meeting. Divide by five to get fifty-eight seconds after Ben starts. The first stopwatch now reads sixty-three seconds.

scenes.heading: One more meeting
scenes.title: One more meeting
scenes.narration: They continue without changing direction. After a meeting they must cover one whole lap between them to meet again. Three hundred divided by five gives sixty more seconds. Which stopwatch gives the time from the first whistle to their second meeting?

scenes.heading: Check the two readings
scenes.title: Check the two readings
scenes.narration: Add sixty to sixty-three. Asha has been running for one hundred and twenty-three seconds. Ben has run for one hundred and eighteen seconds. Their distances are two hundred and forty-six metres and three hundred and fifty-four metres. Together they make six hundred metres, exactly two laps.
